title: Pasta Alla Norma
subtitle: with Eggplant and Basil
description: A celebration of the sweet summery flavours of eggplant, tomato and capsicum – it's no wonder this Sicilian pasta dish is known the world over. Top with aromatic basil and shaved parmesan for complete vegetarian satisfaction.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Cut the eggplant into 1cm chunks (see Kitchen 101). Thickly slice the capsicum. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Pick the basil leaves, then finely chop the stems.

Cook pasta: Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 10 mins or until al dente. Reserve 180ml (¾ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the eggplant, stirring, for 5 mins or until golden. Season with salt and pepper, then remove from the pan.

Saute capsicum: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan over medium-high heat and cook the capsicum, basil stems and garlic, stirring, for 2-3 mins until softened. Add the Tuscan seasoning and 2 tbs tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add the eggplant, half the tomatoes, reserved cooking water and 1 tsp sugar and bring to the boil.

Simmer sauce: Reduce the heat to medium and cook the sauce, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 mins until slightly thickened. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Stir in the pasta and half the basil leaves. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the pasta among bowls, then shave over the cheese using a vegetable peeler. Scatter over the remaining basil and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Only 300g (3½ cups) eggplant is needed for this recipe. If your eggplant looks very large, weigh it using kitchen scales or put the chopped eggplant in a measuring jug to check the quantity.
